words.translation: The pleasant, earthy smell after rain
words.sentence1: After the summer storm, the dry earth released a wonderful petrichor that filled the air. (After the summer storm, the dry earth released a wonderful petrichor that filled the air.)
words.sentence2: She closed her eyes and deeply inhaled the familiar petrichor of the countryside. (She closed her eyes and deeply inhaled the familiar petrichor of the countryside.)

words.translation: The early morning hours, dawn, or daybreak
words.sentence1: Me gusta caminar por las calles tranquilas durante la madrugada. (I like to walk through the quiet streets during the early morning hours.)
words.sentence2: El tren sale muy temprano en la madrugada. (The train leaves very early at dawn.)

words.translation: The joy of reuniting with someone after a long time
words.sentence1: Leurs retrouvailles à la gare ont été remplies d'émotion et de larmes de joie. (Their reunion at the station was filled with emotion and tears of joy.)
words.sentence2: Il y a toujours une grande fête pour marquer nos retrouvailles familiales. (There is always a big celebration to mark our family reunions.)

words.translation: Farsickness; an ache for distant places or wanderlust
words.sentence1: Beim Anblick der alten Landkarte packte ihn sofort das Fernweh. (Looking at the old map immediately filled him with a longing for distant places.)
words.sentence2: Ihr Fernweh trieb sie dazu, all ihre Sachen zu packen und um die Welt zu reisen. (Her wanderlust drove her to pack all her things and travel around the world.)

words.translation: Sunlight filtering through the leaves of trees
words.sentence1: 森の中で浴びる木漏れ日はとても心が癒されます。 (The sunlight filtering through the trees in the forest is very healing to the soul.)
words.sentence2: カメラを持って、美しい木漏れ日の写真を撮りに出かけた。 (I took my camera and went out to take pictures of the beautiful sunlight filtering through the leaves.)

words.translation: The mark left on a table by a cold glass
words.sentence1: Per favore, usa un sottobicchiere per non lasciare un culaccino sul tavolo di legno. (Please, use a coaster so as not to leave a glass ring on the wooden table.)
words.sentence2: La tavola era piena di culaccini dopo la lunga cena tra amici. (The table was full of glass rings after the long dinner among friends.)

words.translation: Destined affinity or a karmic connection between people
words.sentence1: 能够在这里再次相遇，真是前世修来的缘分。 (Being able to meet again here is truly a destined affinity cultivated from a past life.)
words.sentence2: 他们两个人的相识充满了奇妙的缘分。 (Their acquaintance was filled with a wonderful destined connection.)

words.translation: Dazzling or so bright that it hurts the eyes
words.sentence1: 하얀 눈이 내린 풍경이 너무 눈이 부시다. (The landscape covered in white snow is so dazzling.)
words.sentence2: 그녀의 환한 미소가 햇살처럼 눈이 부셨다. (Her bright smile was dazzling like sunlight.)

words.sentence1: ความรักและการให้อภัยคือหัวใจสำคัญของសេចក្តីស្នេហា។ (Love and forgiveness are the core of deep affection.)
words.sentence2: ទឹកមុខរបស់គាត់បង្ហាញពីសេចក្តីស្នេហាដ៏បរិសុទ្ធចំពោះកូនៗ។ (His facial expression showed pure love for his children.)

words.translation: A panoramic view or vista that stretches into the distance
words.sentence1: Van bo op die berg het ons 'n pragtige vergesig oor die hele vallei gehad. (From the top of the mountain, we had a beautiful panoramic view of the entire valley.)
words.sentence2: Die huis is gebou sodat elke kamer 'n wonderlike vergesig bied. (The house was built so that every room offers a wonderful vista.)
